title: I don't want the chat messages truncated. I want full messages. Also, the messages from me

text: I don't want the chat messages truncated. I want full messages. Also, the messages from me, the one that says you, for whatever reason it has a different layout. It seems to be the same CSS, but for some reason it has a different gap. Why is there a different gap on the chat messages from me? I don't see any CSS that reveals why the gap would be different. Dev says card is the CSS class name. But there's no overrides for owner or mastermind. But they have different gap. That's weird. I can't explain why. Why would that be different?
